profile.name: Jhonatan Rodriguez Custodio
profile.tagline: I design multimodal RAG systems and multi-agent architectures in production.
profile.summary: Systems Engineer specialized in Artificial Intelligence, with 3 years of experience building end-to-end AI solutions in cloud environments. Expert in designing, implementing and deploying applications based on large language models (LLMs), multimodal RAG systems, MCP and multi-agent architectures.
profile.summaryExtended: I have solid experience in AI-oriented software development: building data pipelines, integrating OpenAI models, designing APIs and deploying to production on scalable architectures. I build intelligent solutions that automate complex processes by combining LLMs with enterprise data and agent orchestration, improving decision-making and operational efficiency.

highlights: Chat AVI — Document chatbot with multimodal RAG for querying institutional documentation: hybrid search and semantic ranker on Azure AI Search, answers with citations traceable to the source document (Azure OpenAI + GPT-4 Vision), extraction with Document Intelligence and a custom portal with JWT authentication on Cosmos DB.

Smart Recruiting — Automated CV analysis system using Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search and OpenAI models to extract candidate profiles, rank them semantically and make candidate selection more efficient.

Risk Agents — Multi-agent credit-risk system on Azure AI Foundry: an orchestrator splits the evaluation across agents for history, macro/sector context (web search grounding) and financial ratios (OpenAPI tools), consolidating a report with a rating and recommendation.

Corporate Credit Risk Agents — Code-driven orchestrator (Microsoft Agent Framework) coordinating six agents: financial, sector, prior reports, charts, report writer and validator, with tools via MCP, Azure AI Search, Document Intelligence and Cosmos DB, to generate the corporate-banking credit report exportable to Word and PowerPoint.

Document Processor — Serverless extraction of key attributes (Azure Functions + Document Intelligence + Azure OpenAI) from contracts, tax ID records, national IDs, promissory notes and AML/tax documents, with SFTP synchronization and signature validation.

Legal Powers Analyzer — Assistant for analyzing powers of attorney with a document-by-document pipeline that identifies attorneys-in-fact, powers, amount limits and validity, generating downloadable summaries for legal teams.

Document Knowledge — Enterprise knowledge-management platform on AKS, orchestrated with Semantic Kernel, semantic indexing and a decoupled architecture between batch ingestion and a low-latency conversational service.

Dispute Management Agents — Multi-agent dispute management system: six sequential agents (Azure AI Foundry Agent Framework) automating intake, 360° case view, evidence, regulatory research, communication and resolution, with mandatory Human-in-the-Loop before chargebacks.
Transactional Fraud — Analyst agent that weighs customer-behavior evidence and issues a risk verdict justified factor by factor for human review.
ArcGIS Analytics — Consulting and integration of AI-based land valuation using ArcGIS and Databricks to support data-driven strategic decisions.
Improved object-detection precision and efficiency by 20% using YOLO and transfer learning on images and video.
Interactive visualizations and dashboards with Seaborn and Matplotlib for data interpretation and tracking of key KPIs.
Exploratory analysis and data preparation for predictive models.
